title: spermacoce pumila
intro: Spermacoce pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Spermacoce, is a low-growing, perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce pumila include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which help in fighting infections and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
